detail.title: Foundational Reasoning and Path Dependence
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes foundational reasoning assumptions by framing autonomous model behavior through the lens of structural path dependence and geometric constraint representations, formalizing the status of project proj-assumption-challenge-01.

detail.title: Structural Constraints on Foundational Reasoning
